description: Source code for rbus context helper functions managing hash maps, path conversions, context retrieval, and synchronization timing for dynamic tables in a CCSP-style environment.

classes.name: ContextMaps_t
classes.description: Structure holding hash maps for rows, aliases, instances, and dynamic table timestamps.

classes.name: HandlerContext
classes.description: Structure holding context information for a handler, including full name, parameter name, and user data.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a path with aliases into a full path by replacing alias segments.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the parent context object for a given path.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context associated with a specific row path.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a specific row, with optional alias handling.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes row context based on table name and instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes row context based on row name.

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if enough time has elapsed to synchronize a dynamic table.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts the parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes hash maps for context management.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases and cleans up hash maps when no longer needed.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Creates a HandlerContext structure for a given property name.
